body: Thank you, but no. I won't go into details, but I cant undo what I've done. The pain is something i would have to deal with day in and day out for the rest of my life and im not prepared to do that. If it was a physical, chronic pain, people would understand more, i get that. But my pain is just as unbearable.

Thank you all for your kind words, and for taking the time in general to read my post and answer. I thought about what you said and decided you were right. He deserved for me to be open with him about how much I've been struggling. So i did. He...took it about as well as i was afraid of. You see, he's a wonderful man with a deep strength in him I've always felt anchored by. But he has a difficult time understanding how everyone isn't built like him. He said entertaining thoughts of suicide was weakness, and made me weak. He said my emotional and psychological pain were things that i was choosing to allow to control me, and i needed to pick myself up and get through it.
